timeline.title: The Beginning
timeline.desc: Bensi Queen opened as a small neighborhood provisions store in Chitlapakkam, Jothi Nagar — serving a handful of trusted families with quality kitchen essentials.

timeline.title: Growing the Catalogue
timeline.desc: Expanded from core pulses and spices to include premium dry fruits, cold-pressed oils, traditional South Indian masalas, and household essentials — growing to 35+ products.

timeline.title: WhatsApp Ordering
timeline.desc: Launched a simple WhatsApp ordering system to serve busy families who could now order from home without visiting the store, with same-day doorstep delivery.

timeline.title: Online Store Launch
timeline.desc: Launched our full digital storefront to help Chennai families browse the complete catalogue, select custom pack weights, and place orders anytime — 24/7.
